verdict.rationale: Supabase ships an AI Assistant inside its Dashboard that offers context-aware support and automates repetitive tasks, so in-product AI assistance exists. The evidence does not show it generating insights or suggestions from the user's actual data. Advisors are deterministic programmatic checks, not AI, and MCP serves external agents rather than working inside the product, so neither counts toward this story. Missing for 10: documented AI-generated insights or analysis of user data, concrete examples of the suggestions it produces, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Supabase AI Assistant is integrated into the Supabase Dashboard to drastically improve your database management experience.
The AI Assistant can save you hours of work by automating repetitive tasks and providing context-aware support.
